crossRefs.note: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
“If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…
for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

translations.web: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
translations.bsb: He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him disciplines him diligently.
translations.kjv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
translations.asv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son; But he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
